accuracyFlags.claim: Section 05: All Parks Pass 'does not cover camping fees or the Sydney Harbour and Kosciuszko parks in all cases' reads as if Kosciuszko is excluded; no price or date.
accuracyFlags.correct: The All Parks Pass covers vehicle entry at all 45 NSW parks that charge entry fees, including Kosciuszko. $190 for 1 year (seniors $152), $335 for 2 years (seniors $268), checked October 2026. No annual pass covers camping/accommodation fees, Sydney Harbour NP island landing fees, Chowder Bay, or the Kosciuszko Skitube. Multi Park, Country Parks and Single Park passes exclude Kosciuszko.
accuracyFlags.fix: All Parks Pass INCLUDES Kosciuszko: covers all 45 fee parks; $190/1 yr, $335/2 yr (Oct 2026); excludes camping fees, Sydney Harbour island landing fees, Chowder Bay, Skitube

accuracyFlags.claim: Section 04: 'NPWS campgrounds ... most charge both a camping fee and a separate vehicle entry fee'; Keep-in-mind bullet 'NPWS charges camping plus park entry'.
